mapper.sql: t.sys92_management_team_id AS management_team_id, t.sys92_company_id AS company_id, t.sys92_person_id AS person_id, t.sys92_charge_part AS charge_part, t.sys92_work_year AS work_year, t.sys92_main_career AS main_career, t.sys92_note AS note

INNER JOIN ( SELECT emp03_trans.* , emp01_person.* , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd, emp01_company_id, emp03_trans_date) AS emp01_pos_nm FROM emp03_trans INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN org00_org_info ON emp03_org_code_id = org00_org_code_id WHERE emp01_company_id = 1 AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(org00_mod_date) FROM org00_org_info WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp03_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= emp03_trans_date ) AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND x.emp03_trans_date <= f_sysdate() ) AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800', '900') ) emp ON t.sys92_person_id = emp.emp01_person_id
mapper.select:
SELECT , emp.emp01_kor_nm AS person_nm , emp.emp01_pos_nm AS pos_nm , emp.emp01_office_telno AS office_tel_no , emp.emp01_email_addr AS email_addr FROM sys92_management_team t
ORDER BY emp.emp03_pos_cd, emp.emp01_kor_nm

SELECT , emp.emp01_kor_nm AS person_nm , emp.emp01_pos_nm AS pos_nm , emp.emp01_office_telno AS office_tel_no , emp.emp01_email_addr AS email_addr FROM sys92_management_team t
WHERE t.sys92_management_team_id = #{managementTeamId}
SELECT , NULL AS person_nm, NULL AS pos_nm, NULL AS office_tel_no, NULL AS email_addr FROM sys92_management_team t WHERE t.sys92_management_team_id = #{managementTeamId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys92_management_team (sys92_management_team_id, sys92_company_id, sys92_person_id, sys92_charge_part, sys92_work_year, sys92_main_career) VALUES (#{id}, COALESCE(#{r.companyId}, 1), #{r.personId}, #{r.chargePart}, #{r.workYear}, #{r.mainCareer})
